t: You're on Hamilton Terrace, a wide, tree-lined residential road in St John's Wood. It runs north to south from Carlton Hill down to St John's Wood Road, parallel to Maida Vale on the west side. Two people connect to the street. Mark Lascelles, son of the Earl of Harewood and Patricia Tuckwell, was born here in 1964. And Richard Drew, who lived from 1787 to 1843, made his home on this road. It's a quiet street, best enjoyed for its leafy width.
